overview.summary: This is an employment agreement between a fictional company, Example Technologies Private Limited, and A. Sample for the role of Software Engineer in Bengaluru, starting on 1 July 2026. It sets out pay, a six-month probation, working hours, leave and joining formalities. It also includes a 24-month service bond, a 60-day notice period after confirmation, confidentiality and intellectual property terms, and restrictions on other work and on joining competitors after leaving. The document asks for a signed copy within 5 days of 10 June 2026.

key_terms.value: Software Engineer, joining 1 July 2026 in Bengaluru
key_terms.explanation: The job title, team and the date and place the document says employment begins.

source.quote: The Employee shall join the Company on 1 July 2026 at the Bengaluru office.

key_terms.explanation: Cost to company (CTC) is the total yearly cost to the employer; take-home pay is usually lower after deductions. The detailed breakdown is said to be in Annexure A.

source.quote: The Employee shall receive a total cost to company of INR 9,00,000 per annum

key_terms.value: 6 months, extendable by up to 3 months
key_terms.explanation: An initial trial period. The document allows the company to extend it, and a shorter notice period applies during it.

source.quote: The Employee shall be on probation for a period of six months from the date of joining.

key_terms.value: 15 days during probation; 60 days after confirmation
key_terms.explanation: How much written notice either side gives to end employment. It changes once probation is confirmed.

source.quote: After confirmation, either party may terminate this Agreement by giving 60 days written notice.

key_terms.explanation: The document states a minimum service period and an amount towards training costs if the employee resigns earlier, reduced for months already served.

source.quote: The Employee agrees to serve the Company for a minimum period of 24 months from the date of joining.

key_terms.value: 18 days per year; carry forward up to 30 days
key_terms.explanation: Paid days off each calendar year, added on a pro-rata basis, with a cap on how much unused leave can be carried forward.

source.quote: The Employee is entitled to 18 days of paid leave per calendar year

key_terms.value: 9 hours a day (incl. 1-hour break), 5 days a week; transferable within India
key_terms.explanation: Normal hours, with the possibility of additional hours, and a clause allowing transfer to other offices or client locations in India.

source.quote: The Company may transfer the Employee to any of its offices or client locations in India.

responsibilities.title: Return the signed agreement
responsibilities.description: The document asks for a signed copy to be returned to confirm acceptance.

source.quote: Please sign and return a copy of this Agreement within 5 days of the date of this Agreement

responsibilities.title: Submit joining documents
responsibilities.description: Copies of educational certificates, previous relieving letters and identity documents are to be submitted. The appointment is also stated to depend on background verification.

source.quote: identity documents within 7 days of joining

responsibilities.title: Join on the start date
responsibilities.description: The document states the joining date and location.

source.quote: The Employee shall join the Company on 1 July 2026 at the Bengaluru office.

responsibilities.title: Give notice before leaving
responsibilities.description: Written notice is stated as 15 days during probation and 60 days after confirmation.

source.quote: During probation, either party may terminate this Agreement by giving 15 days written notice.

responsibilities.title: Keep information confidential
responsibilities.description: Confidential information of the company and its clients is to be kept confidential during employment and for three years after leaving.
responsibilities.timing: During employment and 3 years after leaving

source.quote: during employment and for a period of three years after leaving the Company.

responsibilities.title: Get consent before other paid work
responsibilities.description: Other employment, business, part-time or freelance work is stated to need the company's prior written consent.

source.quote: without the prior written consent of the Company.

responsibilities.title: Return company property
responsibilities.description: The laptop, access card and all other company property are to be returned.

source.section: 13. Return of Property and Final Settlement
source.quote: On the last working day, the Employee shall return the laptop, access card and all other Company property.

responsibilities.title: Final settlement timeline
responsibilities.description: The document states when the company will process the full and final settlement after exit.
responsibilities.timing: Within 45 days of the last working day

source.section: 13. Return of Property and Final Settlement
source.quote: The full and final settlement shall be processed within 45 days of the last working day.

clauses_to_review.title: Service bond and training cost
clauses_to_review.what_it_says: If the employee resigns before completing 24 months, the document states an amount of INR 1,50,000 towards training costs, reduced for months already served.
clauses_to_review.why_it_matters: It can affect the cost of changing jobs in the first two years, so it helps to know exactly how the amount is calculated and when it applies.
questions_to_ask: What training does the INR 1,50,000 amount relate to, and is there a written breakdown?
How exactly is the amount reduced for months served?
Does this apply if the company ends the employment, or only if I resign?

source.quote: INR 1,50,000 towards training costs, reduced proportionately for the months already served.

clauses_to_review.title: Non-compete after leaving
clauses_to_review.what_it_says: For 12 months after leaving, the document restricts joining or working for any competitor of the company in India, and soliciting its employees or clients.
clauses_to_review.why_it_matters: It may influence future job options, so it is useful to understand how "competitor" is defined and how the company applies this clause.
questions_to_ask: Which companies are considered competitors under this clause?
Is there a list or definition of competitor I can see in writing?
Would a lawyer suggest clarifying this clause before I sign?

source.quote: the Employee shall not join or work for any competitor of the Company in India.

clauses_to_review.title: Notice period and payment in lieu
clauses_to_review.what_it_says: After confirmation the notice period is 60 days. Accepting basic salary instead of serving notice is stated to be at the company's sole discretion.
clauses_to_review.why_it_matters: Notice length and buy-out options affect how quickly you can move to a new role.
questions_to_ask: In practice, how are notice buy-out requests handled?
Can unused leave be adjusted against the notice period?

source.quote: The Company may, at its sole discretion, accept payment of basic salary in lieu of the notice period.

clauses_to_review.title: Ownership of work outside working hours
clauses_to_review.what_it_says: Work created during the period of employment belongs to the company, whether or not it was created during working hours.
clauses_to_review.why_it_matters: If you work on personal projects, open-source contributions or side ideas, it helps to know how this clause applies to them.
questions_to_ask: Does this cover personal projects unrelated to the company's business?
Can I list existing personal projects to exclude them in writing?

source.quote: whether or not during working hours, shall belong exclusively to the Company.

clauses_to_review.title: Transfer and additional hours
clauses_to_review.what_it_says: The document allows transfer to any office or client location in India and states that additional hours may be required when business needs require.
clauses_to_review.why_it_matters: Relocation and extra hours can affect personal plans, so it may help to understand how often these apply and what support is offered.
questions_to_ask: Is relocation support provided if I am transferred to another city?
How are additional working hours recorded or compensated?

source.quote: The Employee may be required to work additional hours when business needs require.

clauses_to_review.title: Extension of probation
clauses_to_review.what_it_says: The company may extend the six-month probation by up to three months at its discretion.
clauses_to_review.why_it_matters: The shorter probation notice period and confirmation timing depend on when probation ends.
questions_to_ask: On what basis is probation extended, and will I be told in writing?
How is confirmation communicated at the end of probation?

source.quote: The Company may extend the probation period by up to three months at its discretion.

missing_or_unclear.title: Salary breakdown not included
missing_or_unclear.detail: The document says the detailed salary structure is in Annexure A, but Annexure A is not part of this document.

source.quote: The detailed salary structure is set out in Annexure A.

missing_or_unclear.title: Bonus criteria not stated
missing_or_unclear.detail: A performance bonus is mentioned, but no amount, criteria or timing is given.

source.quote: Any performance bonus is at the sole discretion of the Company.

missing_or_unclear.title: Training covered by the bond not described
missing_or_unclear.detail: The service bond refers to training costs, but the document does not describe what training is provided.

source.quote: INR 1,50,000 towards training costs

missing_or_unclear.title: "Misconduct" not defined
missing_or_unclear.detail: Termination without notice is linked to misconduct, but the document does not define what counts as misconduct.

source.quote: The Company may terminate this Agreement without notice in case of misconduct.

missing_or_unclear.title: "Competitor" not defined
missing_or_unclear.detail: The 12-month restriction applies to any competitor in India, but the document does not say which companies count as competitors.

source.quote: the Employee shall not join or work for any competitor of the Company in India.

next_steps: Ask HR for Annexure A so you can see the full salary breakdown before signing.
Request written clarification of how the service bond amount is calculated and what training it covers.
Ask how "competitor" and "misconduct" are defined, and whether examples can be provided in writing.
Note the acceptance deadline: the document asks for a signed copy within 5 days of 10 June 2026.
Keep a copy of the signed agreement and any written clarifications for your records.
If any clause remains unclear, consider consulting a qualified lawyer before signing.
